items.title: 3 Fast Growing Stocks With Earnings Growth Up To 120%
items.summary: Rising mentions of inflation on S&P 500 earnings calls are forcing investors to think harder about which businesses can keep growing without relying on cheap money. When costs are under pressure, companies where insiders own a lot and are already pursuing strong expansion plans can look especially compelling. This article examines three such fast-growing companies with significant management ownership, and discusses what that combination could mean for long term investors. The three stocks...

items.title: AppLovin Soars 44% in Two Days on Q3 Beat: “The Transition Is Still in Front of Us”
items.summary: Key TakeawaysAppLovin stock jumped 44% in two days after third-quarter revenue rose 55% and its fourth-quarter guide topped estimates. The slowdown this year’s selloff priced in hasn’t arrived, and the new ad models behind the beat are only partly rolled out.

items.title: AppLovin CEO Says the Business Can “Compound at Roughly 30%” a Year for the Long Term
items.summary: Key TakeawaysAppLovin’s third-quarter revenue rose 55% to $2. 18 billion, and CEO Adam Foroughi said the business can grow about 30% a year over the long term.

items.title: AppLovin Jumps 8% as Post-Earnings Rally Extends; Unity Climbs 7%, Trade Desk Dips
items.summary: AppLovin buyers keep piling in after a blowout quarter, yet the stock still sits far below where it started the year. Can a premium valuation survive the next test, and why are rivals Unity and Trade Desk heading in opposite directions?

items.title: AppLovin (APP) Stock Price Roars After Q3 Earnings Margin Surge
items.summary: AppLovin just dropped its Q3 2026 numbers and the stock did not whisper its verdict. It roared. Coming into the release, the shares already had a strong run, then exploded another 31% in a single session to around US$356. The emotional trigger is clear. Investors locked onto one thing above all else.
